## Checklist
- [ ] Lint, build and tests pass (CI green)
- [ ] `docs/PROGRESS.md` updated (done, decisions, next)
- [ ] No secrets or `.env` values committed

### SEO
- [ ] Title, meta description and canonical correct; one `<h1>`
- [ ] Headings in order; links and images have descriptive text/alt
- [ ] Structured data / sitemap unaffected or updated

### Speed
- [ ] Homepage JS < 90KB gz, CSS < 40KB gz
- [ ] LCP < 1.8s, CLS < 0.05, INP < 200ms (Lighthouse 95+)
- [ ] No render-blocking or unused assets added

### Accessibility

- [ ] Honours `prefers-reduced-motion`; axe check clean

### Mobile
- [ ] Layout works from 320px up; no horizontal scroll
- [ ] Tap targets ≥ 44px; tested at mobile width
